commands.cmd: p=$(command -v ccusage) && echo "resolves: $p -> $(readlink -f "$p")" && ccusage --version && python3 -c "import json,glob,sys;c=sys.argv[1];print('stack',[x['version'] for x in json.load(open('manifests/stack.json'))['components'] if x['id']==c],'winner pins',sorted({w['pin'] for f in glob.glob('catalogs/landscape/*.json') for l in json.load(open(f)).get('layers',[]) for w in (l.get('winners') or []) if w.get('component_id')==c}))" ccusage

t=$(date -u +%Y%m%d); y2=$(date -u -v-2d +%Y%m%d 2>/dev/null || date -u -d '2 days ago' +%Y%m%d); echo "querying this host's real Claude Code logs, UTC $y2..$t"; ccusage claude daily --json --offline --no-cost --timezone UTC --since "$y2" --until "$t" | python3 -c "
import json, sys
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
keys = ('inputTokens', 'outputTokens', 'cacheCreationTokens', 'cacheReadTokens')
rows = d['daily']
per_day_ok = all(sum(r.get(k, 0) for k in keys) == r.get('totalTokens') for r in rows)
grand = d.get('totals', {})
grand_ok = sum(grand.get(k, 0) for k in keys) == grand.get('totalTokens')
models = sorted({m for r in rows for m in r.get('modelsUsed', [])})
has_cost = 'totalCost' in grand or any('cost' in r for r in rows)
print('days:', [r['date'] for r in rows])
print('grand total tokens (counts only, --no-cost):', grand.get('totalTokens'))
print('per-day totals equal sum of their own token-category fields:', per_day_ok, '| grand total equal to sum of its category fields:', grand_ok)
print('models observed:', models, '| any cost field present:', has_cost)
sys.exit(0 if per_day_ok and grand_ok and not has_cost and len(rows) >= 1 else 1)
"
